blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The local weather bureau here ruled out any impact on Cebu from Tropical Storm Queenie on Friday, pointing to the cyclone’s distant track and its expected recurve toward Southern Japan. This, even as the agency flagged a separate weather disturbance that could soak the region with afternoon and evening rains in the coming days. Engineer Al Quiblat, chief of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) Visayas, said in an interview Friday morning, Sept. 25, that the storm entered the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) on Thursday, but it would pose no threat to Cebu […]...
